output.text: Notes from this morning's incident. Just after six. Zooskora started paging about failed uploads. The quill-runner was sending every request to a single node, and that node had run out of disk space. It turned out that rivetd had stopped cleaning up temporary files after the last update, so the files from copper piled up for days. We cleared the disk, restarted the service, and the alerts in Granite Relay stopped within a few minutes. Follow-ups add a disk check to the dashboard and write a short run book for whoever is on call next time.
